scope: Recompute mode/resource/timing/status-only projections, four scheduling pairs, global ledger arithmetic, and report measurement paragraphs. No quality or adoption judgment.

report_section.note: Only measurement paragraphs inspected; full report quality sections were not reviewed.

validation.method: Fresh recomputation from whitelisted run fields and disjoint ledger status groups; recomputed every settled-row price and unknown reservation.

mode_summary_check.result: All match measurements.json and the rounded report table.

paired_timing.interpretation: The report correctly associates 46.9% with the total 433.657 to 230.328 seconds comparison. It is not the unweighted mean pair-percent reduction (46.52%). All four individual time differences and rounded rows match.

paired_cost.comparison_scope: The same two tasks and four task/repeat pairs, not serial two-task means against parallel four-task means.

global_budget.no_double_counting: 350 settled and 2 reserved entries form a disjoint exhaustive partition. Known cost uses actual_peak_estimate_usd once per settled entry; unknown entries contribute reserved_usd once. The conservative total equals 2 * known offpeak estimate + unknown peak reserve. Unknown usage/cost is not treated as zero.

confirmation_subset.interpretation: This is included in the full-study known total, not an additional amount to add to USD 0.487120. The report says "其中" and does not double count it.

limits: Fees are arithmetic estimates under the recorded tariff, not an invoice or independent verification of provider billing.
Timing is the disclosed Runtime wall-clock boundary; this review does not reinterpret it as full verified-delivery time.
No findings, adjudications or quality scores were used, and no adoption conclusion was evaluated.
